newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean inspection destinations - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean inspection destinations - USDA.

text.p: The 28.191 million bushels of U.S. soybeans inspected for export in the week ended Oct 31 were for the following destinations (1,000 bushels):
Toledo to Portugal 651. South Atlantic to Japan 2,109.
Mississippi River to Australia 882; China 4,051; Taiwan 1,122; Colombia 1,132; Greece 869; Japan 4,145; Netherlands 3,718; Spain 2,083 and Thailand 551.
North Texas to Belgium 1,156; France 909 and Venezuela 790.
Puget Sound to Taiwan 386; Indonesia 1,157 and Malaysia 1,249. Interior to Mexico 1,231.
